dataset_rule: Clinic-first public-price audit. Every numeric-priced treatment/service captured from the reviewed official public price pages and business-managed public booking profiles is included, not only flagship Explore categories.
limitations: Best-effort public-web snapshot; hidden, private, login-only, JavaScript-only, image-only, or consultation-only prices may be absent.
Rows without a numeric public price are omitted rather than estimated.
Ratings are null unless a reviewed public booking profile supplied a rating; official clinic pages were not supplemented with third-party ratings.
For pages presenting several prices in one text row, each numeric option is retained and the original price text is preserved in price_note.
Only businesses with a Paris-proper location were eligible. Separate branches of the same named business are grouped under one clinic business.
The final 101-business set prioritizes official medical/aesthetic tariff pages and the strongest qualifying public booking profiles from a larger de-duplicated candidate pool.
